summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Obelisco Manager after P0 Excel import fix and P1 batched state update fix. Backend: 34/34 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All core flows working including the P1 bug fix for 'Pesquisar Todos' button.

success_rate.backend: 100% (34/34 tests passed - 21 original + 13 new P0 tests)

seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded automatically on backend startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 and P1 bug fixes verified. Excel import now correctly handles files with NO header row using column statistics to auto-detect: (1) unit column by matching values against unit tokens, (2) name column by longest avg text length, (3) quantity column as first numeric column after anchor. The 'Pesquisar Todos' button in OrcamentosPage now uses batched state update to avoid React insertBefore errors. All core features tested: Login, Dashboard, Budget CRUD, Excel Import, Proposal generation (3 tiers), PDF export, WhatsApp, Works CRUD, Agenda with calendar, Materials DB CRUD, Labor DB CRUD, Categories, Price Lookup (LLM integration).
